subject: English
question_text: From your reading give an ideas on what does social network mean.
guide_solution: Social networks are some networking websites that interconnect the users and have made the communication easy and simple. By using these websites the users can present themselves before the world by sharing interests and activities.

question_text: 'Websites have become most popular destination of the modern world' Do you support? Why/Why not? Explain in 3/3 sentences.
